name: px87stk
oracle: ARCHITECTURAL SELF-CHECK ONLY -- there is NO QEMU golden and none is possible: QEMU 8.2.2 implements no x87 stack faults at all (fpush()/fpop() in target/i386/tcg/fpu_helper.c never consult fptags, and FPUS_SF is defined at line 59 of that file and used NOWHERE in the i386 target). The oracle is SDM Vol.1 8.5.1 / Table 8-4, asserted in-guest. Every check that fails jumps to the common exit with edi = the check's unique code; pass = edi 0x42 (isa-debug-exit status (0x42<<1)|1 = 133 under QEMU).
oracle_notes: The graded behaviour is the x87 stack-fault RESPONSE (detection is always live; since R2-H06 it is ARM-INDEPENDENT via the det_* descriptor in rtl/core/fpu_writeback.sv, covering the cycle-mode fast arm FK_ARITH/FK_FLDSTI/FK_FLDC/pure-pop FSTP ST(0) as well as the S_FEXEC/S_FSTORE slow arm).

As of the H06 corpus landing the response is UNCONDITIONAL (default-on; the VEN_X87_STKFLT ifdef is gone from fpu_writeback.sv) and the four corpus programs that deliberately drive the stack past its ends (tx_stack, tx_regform, tx_regform2, mb_fxch) carry the x87_stkflt_arch expectation with a 0x4541+st* oracle-gap mask. This test remains the ARCHITECTURAL grading of exactly that behaviour: the full operation x {masked,unmasked} matrix the corpus samples only shallowly.

GRADING on the RTL side is the piretgp0 WITNESS pattern, not an exit status and not a trace diff: with cosim_en==0 the core HALTs on the out 0xf4 with NO retire and no io_req (core_fetch_decode.svh case 2 -- the golden trace must end BEFORE the out), so the TB never learns AL. The exit therefore stages edi=check-code, ebx=#MF-handler count (14), ecx=completed-case count (30), edx=0x600D600D pass magic BEFORE the out, and the gate asserts the final trace record: edi==0x42 && ebx==14 && ecx==30 && edx==0x600D600D. Under QEMU's isa-debug-exit the same code leaves as the process status (133 on pass).

Cycle-mode grading: cycle .vtrace records carry no GPRs, so a --cycle run is graded by PC-STREAM IDENTITY against the functional run of the same image (the image is deterministic; identical instruction stream == identical check outcomes), plus +ven_faultlog (exactly 14 vec=16 deliveries, no other vectors).

A4-H01 (2026-08-04): TWO defects pinned by the M8-M14/U8-U14 + px87stk2 extension. (1) The FIXED-ST1 consumers -- FPATAN/FYL2X/FYL2XP1 (y=ST(1) implicitly, write ST(1) then pop), FSCALE (scales by trunc(ST1)), FPREM/FPREM1 (divisor is ST(1)) -- take NO encoded ST(i), so the R2-H06 det_reads_sti descriptor (keyed on the decoded q_f_sti) never checked their second operand: with ST0 LIVE and ST1 EMPTY they read the stale empty-slot bits with NO #IS at all (fx_fixed_st1 in rtl/core/fpu_writeback.sv now names them and forces det_sti=1; a masked FSCALE with an empty ST1 on a pre-fix build commits ST0 <- scale-by-stale-bits with FSW clean -- case M8 stops at edi=0x40). (2) The operand-read fault decision was evaluated ONLY at the S_FEXEC dispatch clock, but engine/trap/store commits happen states later: without the fp_flt_q/fp_flt_ovf_q latch -> fp_flt_i replay (det_deferred covers S_FP_BUSY/S_TRSC_BUSY/S_FPREM_BUSY/S_FPTRAP_WAIT/S_FSTORE), an UNMASKED fault recorded IE|SF at issue and the deferred commit wrote anyway (engine result over ST0, the store to memory, the pop), and a MASKED fault committed engine output computed from empty-slot bits instead of the QNaN indefinite (e.g. U9's FPREM would retire with ST0 overwritten and only the flags wrong at edi=0x5B; U11's FST m32 would store the stale slot bits, caught at edi=0x63 by the poison readback).

CONFIG SPLIT: px87stk.bin runs on the canonical build (func + cycle) and the FP_PIPE/FP_PIPE2 variants (+VEN_SRT_ITER, so its M13/M14/U13/U14 FDIV/FSQRT cases grade the deferred S_FP_BUSY path there, the direct S_FEXEC path canonically; FPREM/FPREM1 are always the iterative S_FPREM_BUSY engine, +define+VEN_FPREM is in the canonical build). px87stk2.bin runs ONLY on the obj_dir_x87stk_tr variant (+define+VEN_TRANSCENDENTAL +define+VEN_SRT_ITER +define+VEN_FPREM): FPATAN/FYL2X/FYL2XP1 loud-HALT as d_unknown without VEN_TRANSCENDENTAL, and its FDIV/FSQRT cases pin the S_FP_BUSY deferred replay with BOTH operand-emptiness forms (ST0 live ST1 empty; ST0 empty).

RESOLVED DEVIATION (was pinned as a FAILING check, fixed 2026-08-04): case M2 -- a MASKED FLD ST(i) with an EMPTY source must push the QNaN real indefinite 0xFFFFC000000000000000 (SDM Table 8-4: the masked #IS response is the indefinite as the result, pushes included). The RTL substituted QNAN_INDEF only on the fp_we_top/fp_we_sti result paths and on the overflow fp_push_data path; FLD ST(i) commits via fp_we_push with fp_push_data = s_stiv, so it pushed the RAW STALE SLOT BITS (the pre-poisoned 5.0 = 0x4001A000000000000000; a pre-fix build stops at edi=0x07). THE FIX: the fp_push_data substitution in rtl/core/fpu_writeback.sv now covers the underflow push too ((fp_stk_ovf || fp_stk_unf) && fctrl[0]), and every variant passes all 16 cases (edi=0x42, 2254 records -- see validation.results_2026_08_04). The gate is registered PASS (make x87stk).
transitions: real->protected via a minimal GDT (code0 0x08, data0 0x10); CR0.PE|MP|NE set (NE = the internal #MF route, H-12)
own IDT @ 0x1000: vector 16 -> mf_entry (count++, FNCLEX, IRET; FWAIT re-executes clean), vectors 8/13/14 -> distinct-code exits (0x7F/0x7D/0x7E)

M2 masked: FLD ST(1) with an EMPTY source (FK_FLDSTI), every slot pre-poisoned with 5.0's bits -> IE|SF, C1=0, push completes with the indefinite, the one live register preserved (PINNED DEVIATION: the RTL pushes the stale slot bits; fails at edi=0x07)
M3 masked: FXCH %st(1) with an EMPTY partner -> IE|SF, C1=0, TOP unchanged, ST(1)'s tag (fpr[0], TW bits[1:0]) stays EMPTY, ST(0)'s tag stays VALID
M4 masked: FCOM %st(1) EMPTY -> IE|SF, C1=0, masked compare answer UNORDERED (C3=C2=C0=1), no pop
M5 masked: FSTP ST(0) on an EMPTY stack (fast-arm pure pop DD D8) -> IE|SF, C1=0, TOP advances 0->1
M6 masked: FCOMPP with exactly ONE live register (pop2 over an empty ST(1)) -> IE|SF, C1=0, unordered answer, both pops complete (TOP 7->1)

M7 masked: 8xFLD1 + a 9th (overflow onto a live slot, FK_FLDC fast arm) -> IE|SF, C1=1, new ST0 = indefinite, the completing push architecturally destroys the oldest register leaving SEVEN surviving 1.0s

U1..U7: the SAME seven operations with CW.IM=0 -> FSW IE|SF|ES|B (C1 per direction), TOP UNCHANGED, register file/tags bit-identical (proven by FISTP/FNSTENV readback after the pending exception clears), and exactly ONE #MF per case on FWAIT
F1/F2 (control): FXAM on an EMPTY register, masked and unmasked -> C3C2C0=101 (empty class), NO IE/SF, NO ES/B, NO #MF on a following FWAIT
A4-H01 M8 masked: FSCALE with ST0 live ST1 EMPTY (fixed-ST1 consumer, fx_fixed_st1) -> IE|SF, C1=0, ST0 <- QNaN indefinite
A4-H01 M9/M10 masked: FPREM / FPREM1 with ST0 live ST1 EMPTY (iterative engine; commit DEFERRED to S_FPREM_BUSY -- pins the fp_flt_q replay) -> IE|SF, C1=0, ST0 <- indefinite
A4-H01 M11 masked: FST m32 of an EMPTY ST0 (S_FSTORE deferred) -> IE|SF, C1=0, no pop, the stored dword is the QNaN32 0xFFC00000 (NOT the stale slot bits; destination pre-poisoned)
A4-H01 M12 masked: FSTP m32 of an EMPTY ST0 -> IE|SF, C1=0, stored dword 0xFFC00000, the pop COMPLETES (TOP 0->1)
A4-H01 M13/M14 masked: FDIV ST0,ST1 with ST1 EMPTY / FSQRT with ST0 EMPTY -> IE|SF, C1=0, ST0 <- indefinite (direct S_FEXEC path canonically; deferred S_FP_BUSY on the SRT_ITER pipe variants)

A4-H01 U8..U14: the SAME seven operations with CW.IM=0 -> FSW IE|SF|ES|B, TOP UNCHANGED, NOTHING commits (ST0 intact 5.0 / destination keeps its 0x0B0B0B0B poison -- NO store, NO pop / tags all empty), and exactly ONE #MF per case on FWAIT

px87stk2.S (SECOND image, obj_dir_x87stk_tr variant ONLY): TM1-TM3 masked FPATAN/FYL2X/FYL2XP1 with ST0 live ST1 EMPTY -> ST(1) <- indefinite, the pop completes, IE|SF, C1=0; TU1-TU3 unmasked -> nothing commits (no ST(1) write, NO pop, ST0 intact), one #MF each; DM1-DM3 masked FDIV ST0,ST1 (ST1 empty AND ST0 empty forms) / FSQRT (ST0 empty) with VEN_SRT_ITER -> deferred S_FP_BUSY commit substitutes the indefinite; DU1-DU3 unmasked -> the deferred commit is fully suppressed, one #MF each
FNINIT cleanup between every case; isa-debug-exit (AL=0x42) on all-pass

Verified by FSTPT/FISTP readback, FSW fields, and TOP tracking

negative_control.method: git archive HEAD rtl into /tmp/ven_h06_head (HEAD = 4a643c1, pre-R2-H06: detection on the SLOW arm only, no det_* descriptor, no masked-response substitution on the direct result paths, no compare-unordered answer) and build with make -C verif/tb rtl OBJDIR=obj_dir_h06head RTL_DIR=/tmp/ven_h06_head/rtl VL_EXTRA_DEFINES=+define+VEN_X87_STKFLT; run the SAME image
negative_control.expected: fast-arm cases go UNDETECTED in cycle mode and the masked response is missing everywhere: cycle mode stops at check 0x01 (M1 flags -- the masked FADD ST0,ST1 with ST1 empty raises NOTHING on the fast arm); functional mode stops at 0x03 (slow arm detects, but ST0 gets the raw eval, not the indefinite)
negative_control.measured: CONFIRMED 2026-08-04: HEAD cycle = 1868 retired, stops at check 0x01 (M1 flags, pc 0xf0148 -> edi=1 path); HEAD func = 1873 retired, edi=0x03 (M1 indefinite mid-word); HEAD record-and-continue probe bitmap 0x000050CC = checks {03,04,07,08,0B,0D,0F} failing (M1/M2 indefinite data, M3 FXCH flags, M4 FCOM-empty detection, M6 pop2 unordered answer) vs 0x000000C0 = {07,08} on the first fixed build (the then-pinned M2 push-data deviation). After the same-day M2 fix (the underflow-push QNaN substitution) the probe bitmap is 0x00000000: all four variants (func/cycle/FP_PIPE/FP_PIPE2) retire 2254, edi=0x42, ebx=7, ecx=16, PC-stream-identical, 7x vec=16 and no other vector.
negative_control.a4_h01_discrimination (2026-08-04, by RT: The M8-M14/U8-U14 + px87stk2 cases discriminate the two A4-H01 defects directly. (1) Pre-fix, fx_reads_sti covered only ops with an ENCODED ST(i); FSCALE/FPREM/FPREM1/FPATAN/FYL2X/FYL2XP1 take ST(1) implicitly, so with ST0 live and ST1 EMPTY the det_* descriptor read fptag[ftop + q_f_sti] for an operand the op does not have -- NO #IS was raised at all: masked FSCALE (case M8) would commit ST0 <- 5.0 * 2^trunc(stale empty-slot bits) with FSW clean, stopping at edi=0x40 (flags), and even if detection had fired the result would be garbage instead of the indefinite (edi=0x41-0x43). (2) Pre-fix the fault decision lived only at the S_FEXEC dispatch clock: a deferred commit (S_FPREM_BUSY engine done-clock, S_FP_BUSY divide/sqrt, S_TRSC_BUSY transcendental, S_FSTORE) replayed NOTHING -- an UNMASKED FPREM with an empty divisor (case U9) would have its engine result written over ST0 anyway (edi=0x5D, or 0x5B flags), and an unmasked FST m32 of an empty ST0 (case U11) would STORE the stale slot bits to memory (edi=0x63, the poison readback).

px87stk3.finding: the full narrowing-store stack-fault matrix (every decoded narrowing-store form x {masked, unmasked}), self-checked like the parent image
px87stk3.case_map: 21 cases: masked FST m32 / FSTP m32 / FST m64 / FSTP m64 / FIST m16 / FISTP m16 / FIST m32 / FISTP m32 / FISTP m64 / FBSTP of an EMPTY ST0 (the store completes with the destination-specific indefinite: 0xFFC00000, 0xFFF8000000000000, 0x8000, 0x80000000, 0x8000000000000000, and the packed-BCD indefinite 80'hFFFFC000000000000000 = memory bytes 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 C0 FF FF; IE|SF, C1=0, TOP unchanged for non-popping forms and advanced exactly once for popping forms) + the same ten unmasked (destination poison 0x0B0B0B0B untouched -- no bus request at all --, TOP/tags unchanged, IE|SF|ES|B, one #MF each) + case B1 (the suppressed-FBSTP engine-launch regression: an unmasked FBSTP of an empty ST0 retires suppressed, FNCLEX without FWAIT clears the pending #MF state, +0.0 is loaded, and a second FBSTP to a fresh buffer follows within the engine's ~60-clock busy window; the stored bytes must be the exact packed-BCD conversion of the NEW value -- all zero -- not the suppressed op's stale-slot conversion, and the suppressed op's destination keeps its poison). Slot poisoning: all eight FP slots are filled with 1.0's bits and emptied in the prologue, so a masked response that converted the stale slot shows 0x3F800000 / 1 / BCD-1 instead of the indefinite

px87stk3.variants: canonical obj_dir (func + --cycle PC-identity), obj_dir_x87stk_bcd (+define+VEN_BCD_ITER; px87stk3 func+cycle, plus px87stk func for its m32 store cases), obj_dir_x87stk_psall (+define+VEN_FP_PS_ALL +define+VEN_FPTRAP and -DVEN_FPTRAP in the TB CFLAGS so the TB trap service is compiled in; px87stk3 func+cycle). px87stk/px87stk2 do NOT run on the PS-trap build: they set up values with FILD/arithmetic, which PS-trap, and the TB service answers every trap with one fixed computation (the image px87stk3 deliberately uses only PL-resident x87 ops: FNINIT/FLDCW/FLD1/FSTP ST(0)/FNSTSW/FNSTENV/FWAIT/FNCLEX; masked narrowing stores discard the PS result for the indefinite, so the fixed PS answer never reaches memory)
px87stk3.rtl_defect_found: REPORTED 2026-08-04: the masked-response substitution table's FBSTP entry (rtl/core/core.sv, the FX_FBSTP arm of the fstore_val unique case) is 80'hFFFFC0000000000000 -- 18 hex digits (72 bits), so byte 9 of the 10-byte destination stores 0x00 and bytes 6-8 hold C0 FF FF, one byte lower than the architectural packed-BCD indefinite 80'hFFFFC000000000000000 (20 hex digits) used by the proven fx_fx_to_bcd (rtl/fpu/fpu_x87_pkg.sv) and ven_bcd engine paths. Measured on the canonical TB: a masked FBSTP of an empty ST0 stores dword0=0x00000000, dword1=0xFFC00000, word8=0x00FF (bytes ...00 00 C0 FF FF 00) instead of dword1=0xC0000000, word8=0xFFFF (...00 00 00 C0 FF FF). px87stk3 case M10 checks 0x18/0x19 pin the architectural value and FAIL on the current RTL; every other case (19/20) passes on all three builds. NOT worked around in the test; awaiting the one-token RTL fix (append the missing two hex digits).

description: REVIEW1_Aug3 R2-H06 + REVIEW_Aug4 A4-H01 architectural regression: the x87 stack-fault matrix. px87stk.bin: 30 cases in one 64 KiB BIOS image -- the R2-H06 sixteen {seven faulting shapes x {masked, unmasked}, plus the FXAM-on-empty control x2} and the A4-H01 fourteen {FSCALE / FPREM / FPREM1 with ST0 live ST1 EMPTY (the fixed-ST1 consumers the canonical build decodes; FPREM/FPREM1 commit deferred in S_FPREM_BUSY), FST m32 / FSTP m32 of an EMPTY ST0 (S_FSTORE deferred; masked stores the QNaN32 0xFFC00000, unmasked stores NOTHING and does not pop), FDIV ST0,ST(i) with ST1 EMPTY / FSQRT with ST0 EMPTY} x {masked, unmasked}. px87stk2.bin (obj_dir_x87stk_tr variant only): 12 cases -- FPATAN / FYL2X / FYL2XP1 with ST0 live ST1 EMPTY (transcendental fixed-ST1 consumers, deferred S_TRSC_BUSY commit) and the S_FP_BUSY deferred FDIV (both operand-emptiness forms) / FSQRT shapes, masked + unmasked. px87stk3.bin: 20 cases -- every decoded narrowing-store form (FST/FSTP m32/m64, FIST/FISTP m16/m32, FISTP m64, FBSTP) x {masked, unmasked} on an empty ST0, pinning the destination-specific masked indefinite and the fully-suppressed unmasked retire on the canonical, iterative-BCD, and PS-trapped builds. Masked: the op completes with the QNaN real indefinite (compares answer unordered C3=C2=C0=1), IE|SF set, C1 = direction. Unmasked: nothing commits (register file/tags/TOP bit-identical, no store transaction), IE|SF|ES|B recorded, and #MF is delivered exactly once at the next waiting FP instruction. Self-checked against the SDM (QEMU implements no stack faults -- no golden possible); graded RTL-side from the final trace record (edi/ebx/ecx/edx witnesses) and the +ven_faultlog, cycle-mode by PC-stream identity with the functional run. The one deviation the R2-H06 matrix originally pinned (the masked FLD ST(i)-empty-source push delivering the raw stale slot bits, edi=0x07) was fixed the same day; all configurations now pass (make x87stk).
